title: MIPI UniPro-Mem: UniPro data link layer (ESC_DL / COF framing, CRC-16, NAC retransmission, TC1 over TC0 priority) carrying a memory-mapped transaction layer (writes / reads of a 64 x 32-bit memory with a read timeout) and PACP attribute get / set

irqs.name: ERR
irqs.desc: received CRC error, out-of-bounds or invalid-length memory request, NAC retransmit budget exhausted, or a response dropped because its traffic-class slot was still occupied

notes: rx_sym / rx_valid (symbols in), tx_sym / tx_valid / tx_ready (symbols out with back-pressure) pass through unchanged.
Memory and attributes are reached over the UniPro link only; the registers report its errors.
